description: This file defines the HelpService class within the OrangeHRM Help plugin, responsible for managing help configuration, help processors, and URL handling related to help features.

classes.name: HelpService
classes.description: Service class providing help-related functionalities including configuration retrieval, processor management, and URL validation.

methods.name: getHelpConfigService
methods.description: Returns the HelpConfigService instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getHelpProcessor
methods.description: Returns the help processor instance, creating a new one based on configuration if not already instantiated.

methods.name: getRedirectUrl
methods.description: Fetches the redirect URL for a given help label via the help processor.

methods.name: getDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Retrieves the default redirect URL from the help processor.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if the base help URL from configuration is a valid URL.
